Prefecture|Shimane]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=1 July 2021}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 1 July 2021, sixty Sites have been [[Cultural Properties of Japan|designated]] as being of national [[Values {{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Shimane Prefecture|Shimane]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency [[en:List of Historic Sites of Japan (Shimane)]] {{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Shimane Prefecture|Shimane]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Shimane Prefecture|Shimane]].{{cite web
